verdicts.reason: A keeps the can large on the left with the text stacked on the right, but the subtitle runs to within about 20px of the right edge, the dark panel's hard top-left edge cuts through the background just beside the can, and the logo is squeezed against the top edge above the panel's corner. B shrinks the can so the product becomes minor, places the can across the panel's right edge (a collision), uses an oversized CTA pill that competes with the headline, and puts the logo against the top edge; the subtitle and button are also not aligned with the centred headline.
